source_refs.note: Exercise 4.1, Question 7: RL circuit, charging recalled, discharging deduced; book p. 128, answers p. 303 (PDF 305, printed as item 8)

blocks.prompt: 7 For an RL circuit, recall the differential equation representing the charging of an inductor. Deduce the differential equation that represents the discharging of the inductor.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh Question 6 ka judwa (twin) sawal hai, bas capacitor ki jagah inductor hai.
Pehle Example 4(ii) ki charging equation yaad karni hai, phir source hata kar discharging ki equation nikalni hai.
Source hata dein (\(V_{S} = 0\)) to current resistor ke zariye aahista aahista khatam hota hai.
Plan: charging equation likh kar \(V_{S} = 0\) rakhna aur \(\frac{dI}{dt}\) akela karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: RL circuit; Example 4(ii) ki charging equation.
Maloom karna: discharging ki equation.
Tareeqa: charging equation yaad kar ke \(V_{S} = 0\) rakhna.

Charging equation yaad kijiye
\[L\dfrac{dI}{dt} + RI = V_{S}\]
ya
\[L\dfrac{dI}{dt} = V_{S} - RI\]
Kyun: Kirchhoff's voltage law \(V_{L} + V_{R} = V_{S}\), jahan \(V_{L} = L\frac{dI}{dt}\) aur \(V_{R} = RI\).

Discharging: source nahi
\[L\dfrac{dI}{dt} = -RI\]
\[\dfrac{dI}{dt} = -\dfrac{R}{L}I\]
Kyun: battery na ho to loop law \(V_{L} + V_{R} = 0\) ban jata hai. Inductor kuch der current ko chalaye rakhta hai (jaise chalti cycle pedal chhorne ke baad bhi kuch door jati hai), aur resistor us ki energy kharch kar deta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(L\) se divide karein to \(\frac{R}{L}\) aata hai, \(\frac{L}{R}\) nahi.
Ghor kijiye ke Question 6 aur Question 7 ke jawab ek hi shakal ke hain: \(\frac{dq}{dt} = -\frac{1}{RC}q\) aur \(\frac{dI}{dt} = -\frac{R}{L}I\). Dono decay models hain, bilkul radioactive decay ki tarah; sirf constant alag hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(I = I_{0}e^{-Rt/L}\) is equation ko poora karta hai (sympy): current \(I_{0}\) se zero tak ghatta hai. Key ka jawab \(\frac{dI}{dt} = -\frac{R}{L}I\) (item 8 par chhapa) milta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key yeh jawab item 8 par chhapti hai (us ka faltu item 6 is exercise ke kisi sawal ka nahi). Jawab khud, \(\frac{dI}{dt} = -\frac{R}{L}I\), sahi hai.
